name: CVEL: Sentinel ICBM test shot from Faslane
description: A two-stage CVEL Sentinel ICBM on its pad at Faslane in Scotland, loaded with a 20 kt Fat Man re-entry vehicle. Open an MFD (F5) and choose ICBM Targeting: enter the target's latitude and longitude, choose air or ground burst, the burst height and a yield from 20 kt to 1 Mt, then ARM and LAUNCH. The default target is a test point in the Atlantic about 4,800 km (3,000 miles) away.
